spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (गुम्फति)
To string together as a garland, &c.

m. (-म्फः)
1 Tying, stringing as a garland, &c.
2 A bracelet.
3 A whisker, a mustachio.
E.
गुम्फ to tie or string, affix अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Tied, strung.
2 Arranged, placed in order.
E.
गुम्फ to tie, affix क्त; also गुफित, and ग्रन्थित.
